// Package lintcanary is written into the tree by .github/ci/lint.sh for one
// lint run and removed afterwards. Each function below trips exactly one of the
// five gate linters. If any of the five is missing from the report, the linter
// did not run, did not load the code, or new-code filtering hid new code, and
// the gate is red. Never commit this as a .go file.
package lintcanary

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// errcheck: the error from Atoi is dropped.
func CanaryErrcheck() {
	strconv.Atoi("1")
}

// govet (printf): %d with a string.
func CanaryGovet() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", "one")
}

// ineffassign: the first value of n is never read.
func CanaryIneffassign() int {
	n := 1
	n = 2
	return n
}

// staticcheck SA4017: the result of a pure function is discarded.
func CanaryStaticcheck() {
	strings.ToUpper("x")
}

// unused: never called.
func canaryUnused() {}
